messages:
mike: Noticed a climb in partial-stream responses from 08:1208:40 UTC, approx 1.2% of sessions.

ana: Looking at edge traces. Handshake and first token always make it, then no further tokens for ~46s, client usually reconnects and resumes. Suspect keepalive mismatch or streaming idle heuristics.

devon: I reproduced on canary with client-sdk v1.4.2 + 10ms packet loss sim. Async decoder falls back to CPU; right before stall I see a KV cache eviction spike.

nina: I can run a mitigation canary: lower stream idle timeout and add a lightweight heartbeat frame. Will own rollout and monitoring. :thumbsup:

mike: Assignments: nina -> mitigation canary (48h), devon -> root-cause async-decoder + kv eviction (5d), ana -> verification & SLA impact (72h).

ana: Canary config (staging first):
```
stream.keepalive_interval_ms = 15000
stream.max_idle_before_backoff_ms = 30000
client.reconnect_policy = "linear:250ms,500ms,1s"
```
Enabling verbose stream traces for 72h.

devon: For root cause I'll add eviction counters and async-worker latency histograms. If eviction correlates, plan to raise soft threshold + add per-request pinning to avoid mid-request evictions.

ops-bot: Created synthetic job `synthetic/stream-regression-check` running every 6h, posting to #eng-oncall.

nina: Canary rollout plan: staging -> 10% prod (6h) -> 50% (12h) -> 100% if no regressions. Abort criteria: partials >0.5% or error-rate delta >0.2%.

mike: Also adding a recurring check to correlate partials with deployments and pods with short terminationGracePeriod (pattern observed). ana owns weekly check for 4 weeks.

ana: I'll add a runbook snippet for oncall (where to find traces, quick triage steps, key metrics) and create the incident tracker entry.

mike: Following up in 48h here with mitigation status. Thanks team. :rocket:
